title: RW Aurigae — a young variable star
plain_result: Not measured yet. 225 SPHEREx pictures of this variable star are available in the Time Machine. We tried a per-star test (one brightness per picture, colour removed, compared with ordinary stars), but this star saturates SPHEREx's detector in most pictures: our fit of its outer light is poor, so a change cannot be told apart from a bad fit (What failed #16). The counts below are for the whole patch of sky, not for the star itself.

numbers.label: Flagged changes, one detector at a time

method_note: Counts use the same rule as the 20-patch test (groups of ≥ 2 pixels beyond 5σ).
